summary: A 39-year-old Australian male mountain biker from Vail crashed descending off Reno Ridge toward Flag, suffering broken ribs and internal injuries; a riding companion rode out to Cement Creek Road for cell signal and called 911 (~1:30 p.m.). CBSAR team leader Ric Ems and Mt. CB officer John Turco responded; a CareFlight helicopter from Montrose was initially cancelled at the patient's request, then re-called after SAR member/PA Jeff Isaac's evaluation, landing atop Reno Divide Ridge (~11,200 ft) ~4:30 p.m.; the patient was flown to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction.
location: Reno Divide Ridge, off Reno Ridge toward Flag, above Cement Creek Road
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue / Mt. Crested Butte Police / CareFlight
